modelFamily.readBy: which rate card and context window a model name belongs to

billing.readBy: whether a session bills a plan or an API account

usage.readBy: every run prints its cost and is held to its cap

usage.tokens: the transcript's usage entries, once per message id

questionTools.readBy: which tool calls are questions to the person

transcripts.readBy: a run keeps its session's own transcript

errorTexts.readBy: a stop's cause from the texts the agent writes; a stop that matches none is unknown, never a pass

events.readBy: each hook's strict payload schema per covered version; a missing or retyped field reads unverified

mapping.readBy: the adapter maps each hook payload to events by these entries, and deep explain names the entry behind each event

toolKinds.readBy: a tool call's kind by tool name or name prefix; unknown is what guards treat as change

toolDetail.readBy: what a call of each kind carries: a shell call's command, a file call's paths, an MCP call's tool under this field

patch.readBy: a patch's paths from its marker lines, through apply_patch or a shell command that runs it

turnWithoutPrompt.readBy: a turn no prompt hook started opens with a user.ask whose origin the transcript's opening user message names

signIn.readBy: a run is BLOCKED until the agent is signed in

stop.readBy: each agent.stop names its cause and carries its usage

cause.readBy: the payload first, then error records, then the last rate limit

usage.readBy: the turn's assistant entries' message.usage, once per message.id, since each content block repeats it; input is input_tokens plus cache_creation_input_tokens, cached is cache_read_input_tokens, each exact; an API error's synthetic entry (model <synthetic>) carries zeros, not usage, so it is left out; the model is the last entry's message.model; no context window and no cost is recorded, so context_fill is null and the cost unpriced

readUsage.readBy: a turn's usage from the transcript: the model that answered, tokens by the agent's own count, a cost only with its basis
